AI Cloud Infra +94% y/y is real but small next to the ad decline; five straight quarters of falling revenue by Q2. The SOTP cash cushion is therefore a pile management is deploying, not a trapped asset, and the screen's EV of $122bn counts debt without the cash.

name: JD.com, Inc.

evidence: Q3 2026 release (6-K, 2026-11-17): revenue RMB309.6bn (+3.5%), group operating income RMB5.2bn, JD Retail operating income RMB15.1bn (vs RMB14.8bn a year ago, 5.8% margin), marketing expense -26% to RMB15.5bn as New Businesses spending narrowed 'significantly' y/y. The retail core is not growing (flat operating income), the market doubts that the delivery war ends and that management stops buying (CECONOMY for EUR1.34bn), and Chinese-ADR discount applies; the retail core itself is intact.
